messages.content: Recheck the coastal weekend before the refundable rate expires. I want the actual three-night totals, cancellation terms, drive time to the Sunday kayak, and whether either of us can still get a treatment.

All three properties still have rooms for September 26-29, but the pricing has changed. Bodega Coast Inn is $1,486.62 total for three nights and is about 35 minutes from the Jenner kayak pickup. Timber Cove Resort is $1,932.48 total and about 20 minutes from pickup. Harbor House Hotel is $1,354.17 total and about 42 minutes away. I am checking the deposit, cancellation language, and spa schedule against those offers now.
The original plan split the stay. Are these totals for staying in one place all three nights?

Yes. These are comparable Friday-through-Monday totals at one property. The earlier split plan has also increased: two nights at Bodega Coast Inn plus Sunday at Timber Cove is now $1,786.40. That is $299.78 more than staying at the inn for all three nights, before spa charges.
Give me the terms on the three single-property choices first.

Bodega Coast Inn requires a one-night deposit of $442.18. Its refundable offer can be canceled without penalty through 3:00 p.m. local time seven days before arrival; after that, the deposit is forfeited. That offer expires in two days. Timber Cove Resort charges the full $1,932.48 at booking and allows cancellation through 4:00 p.m. five days before arrival, after which the full stay is nonrefundable. Harbor House Hotel takes a $390.60 first-night deposit and allows cancellation until 6:00 p.m. three days before arrival; a later cancellation forfeits the deposit.
And the spa? We had Saturday afternoon penciled in as day guests.

The Saturday paired openings are gone. Timber Cove now has one 80-minute massage Sunday at 3:10 p.m. and one 50-minute massage at 4:40 p.m.; they cannot start together. Bodega Coast Inn and Harbor House have no treatment rooms. The nearby day spa has one 50-minute appointment Saturday at 4:20 p.m., but nothing for a second guest that day. The resort appointments are currently available to overnight guests and would add $455.40 including service charge.
Could we finish the 10:00 kayak and make the 3:10 appointment without rushing?

Yes. The guided outing is scheduled to finish around 12:30 p.m. Timber Cove is about a 20-minute drive from the pickup point, leaving roughly two hours after allowing time to change and have lunch. The later appointment ends around 5:30 p.m. The schedule works, though the treatments would be sequential rather than paired.
Compare the complete lodging-and-spa numbers. Include the kayak and fuel too, but leave meals out.

The estimated trip totals are: Bodega Coast Inn $1,697.02 with one Saturday treatment, kayak, and fuel; Timber Cove Resort $2,597.88 with both Sunday treatments, kayak, and fuel; Harbor House Hotel $1,564.57 with one Saturday treatment, kayak, and fuel. Without any treatment, the inn is $1,696.62, Timber Cove is $2,142.48, and Harbor House is $1,564.17. The one-treatment figures include an estimated $212.40 at the day spa.
The inn total with one treatment looks only forty cents higher than without one. That cannot be right.

Correct. I carried the day-spa amount incorrectly. The corrected Bodega Coast Inn total with one treatment is $1,909.02: $1,486.62 lodging, $212.40 treatment, $140 kayak, and $70 fuel. Harbor House with that treatment is $1,776.57. The no-treatment totals remain unchanged.

Stay with Bodega Coast Inn for all three nights. Select the refundable room before it expires, but do not reserve the single spa slot. We will skip treatments if there is no way to schedule both of us. Book the kayak as planned.

Bodega Coast Inn is selected for September 26-29 at $1,486.62 total under the refundable offer. A $442.18 deposit was charged, and cancellation is permitted through 3:00 p.m. local time seven days before arrival; the deposit is forfeited after that deadline. The Sunday 10:00 a.m. Jenner estuary kayak is booked for two at $140. No spa appointment was reserved. With estimated fuel, the confirmed and expected trip total is $1,696.62 excluding meals. The split stay and Timber Cove room are no longer part of the plan.
